weeks.goal: Stand up the agency's full tech stack, accounts and team norms so building can start on solid rails.
Turn the brand kit into design tokens and ship the homepage and service-page framework to staging.
Launch the production website with complete service pages, INR pricing, payments and technical SEO.
Build sample work and publish the first case studies, blog and SEO deliverable templates.
Ship the inbound + outbound lead engine: lead magnet, analytics dashboard, capture and outreach systems.
Run structured prospecting, send the first proposals and convert the first discovery calls.
Build onboarding, project management and reusable delivery assets, then deliver for the first client.
Launch the first client, collect proof, refine offers and automate reporting and ops.
Publicly launch the agency, optimize post-launch and set the next-quarter technical roadmap.
